AMENDMENT
to the Loan Agreement dated 4 April 2019 (“Loan Agreement”), by and between
Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“Lender”) and Zameen Arcs (Private) Limited
(“Borrower”)
[Each a “Party” and, collectively, “Parties”]
This Amendment (“Amendment”) to the Loan Agreement, is made and entered into at Lahore on
this 3rd day of April 2020 (“Execution Date”), by and between the Parties.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Amendment shall be effective from the Execution Date.

2.

The Credit Limit as referred in Clause (1) of the Loan Agreement shall be enhanced from
Rs. 300,000,000 (Rupees three hundred million) to Rs. 400,000,000 (Rupees four hundred
million).

3.

The term for utilization of the Credit Facility, as referred in Clause 2 of the Loan Agreement,
shall be increased from one (1) year to five (5) years. The Borrower may utilize the Credit
Facility as per its requirements, at the Borrower’s option through direct or indirect payments,
transfer of funds or, direct payments made to or on behalf of the Borrower, from time to
time, up to a maximum of the Credit Limit.

4.

This Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Loan Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Loan Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event
of any conflict, the provisions of this Amendment shall prevail and any conflicting term in
the Loan Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Loan Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this Amendment, unless otherwise specified.
